known_issues: JSON export/delete/import round-trip results in incorrect calculations (e.g., total owed to driver should be $85 but is wrong).
App/build shows runtime error: "Actor not initialized" (user requesting fix).
App stuck spinning on "initializing" indefinitely (actor readiness never completes).

existing_features.title: Update the "Owed Driver" calculation shown in the daily totals UI to include voucher-paid tips, matching the report/backend formula: ((credit meter + voucher meter − cash meter) / 2) + credit tips + voucher tips.

Prevent the app from routing an authenticated user into Account Setup or Main App until the backend actor has finished initializing (or has failed with a visible error state), so that no page can trigger mutations while `actor` is null.

Update `useActor` to expose an explicit, reliable actor readiness and error status (e.g., `isLoading`/`isReady`/`error`) that consumers can use to gate queries and UI, and ensure React Query’s actor query has sensible retry behavior for transient initialization failures.

Ensure all mutations that currently throw `Error('Actor not initialized')` are unreachable from the UI while the actor is not ready, and replace any remaining occurrences with a consistent, user-friendly English message if the condition is ever hit (as a defensive fallback).

Update the backend actor initialization flow to never leave authenticated users stuck on an indefinite “Initializing…” UI; if actor creation or `initializeAccessControl()` fails, the UI must transition to a visible error state with clear next actions.

Update `frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts` and `frontend/src/components/ActorInitializationGate.tsx` to use the new readiness/error status and display an error Alert UI (with a Retry button) when initialization fails.

new_feature_requests.summary: Enhance `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts` to expose explicit actor readiness and error status (e.g., `isLoading`, `isReady`, `isError`, `error`) and provide a real `refetch`/retry mechanism that consumers can call.

projectName: Fix Owed Driver total after JSON export/import round-trip
